paper_title: Evaluation of Speaker Anonymization on Emotional Speech
caption: Original distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset. Percentages are displayed with respect to number of utterances.
model_annotation: This pie chart displays the original distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset, with percentages calculated with respect to the number of utterances. The chart is divided into six slices representing distinct emotion categories. The largest slice corresponds to "Frustration," shown in yellow, accounting for 25.1% of the utterances. The second largest slice represents "Neutral," depicted in a light orange or peach color, at 23.1%. "Anger" is shown in a light blue or cyan color and comprises 14.9% of the dataset. "Sadness," rendered in a golden or dark yellow hue, accounts for 14.7%. "Excitement" appears in blue and represents 14.1% of the utterances. The smallest slice corresponds to "Happiness," shown in a dark blue or purple color, at 8.1%. Percentage labels are displayed inside or adjacent to each slice, and category labels are positioned outside the chart with lines or proximity indicating their corresponding segments. The slices appear to be arranged roughly in descending order of size moving clockwise from the top, with the exception of "Sadness" and "Excitement" being nearly equal in proportion. No separate legend is included, as labels are placed directly alongside the chart. None of the slices appear to be visually exploded or offset from the center.
